title: Lexical Equivalence Clustering
description:
Given a list of strings, group together those that are anagrams of each other. An anagram is a word formed by rearranging the letters of another, using all the original letters exactly once. The order of the resulting groups and the strings within them does not matter.

Example 1
Input:
strs = ["eat","tea","tan","ate","nat","bat"]
Output:
[["bat"],["nat","tan"],["ate","eat","tea"]]

Example 2
Input:
strs = [""]
Output:
[[""]]

Example 3
Input:
strs = ["a"]
Output:
[["a"]]
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n representing the number of strings.
The next n lines each contain a single string.
output_format: Print each group of anagrams on its own line, with strings in each group separated by spaces.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000
0 <= strs[i].length <= 100
strs[i] consists of lowercase English letters
